sentences.en: Every week, Mrs. May took some of the children to the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 每周，

sentences.en: The children were good swimmers and they liked going with Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: 孩子们是游泳健将，他们喜欢和 May 夫人一起去。

sentences.en: The children were taking a swimming test.
sentences.zh: 孩子们正在参加游泳测试。

sentences.en: "It's time to begin," Said Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: “该开始了。” 老师说道。

sentences.en: "Who wants to go first?" "We do," Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: “谁想先来？” “我们想。” Nadim 说道。

sentences.en: Biff, Chip, Wilma and Nadim jumped into the pool.
sentences.zh: Biff、Chip、Wilma 和娜丁跳进了泳池。

sentences.en: The water was warm.
sentences.zh: 水很暖和。

sentences.en: "Off you go," Called Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: “你走吧。” 给梅

sentences.en: They had to swim up and down the pool.
sentences.zh: 他们必须在泳池里来回游。

sentences.en: They had to swim ten lengths.
sentences.zh: 他们必须游10个来回。

sentences.en: Wilma was first to swim ten lengths and Biff and Nadim were next.
sentences.zh: Wilma 第一个游完了10个来回，Biff 和 Nadine 紧随其后。

sentences.en: It was hard for Chip to swim the ten lengths.
sentences.zh: Chip 游完10个来回很辛苦。

sentences.en: "Come on, Chip," Called Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: “加油，Chip，” 给梅

sentences.en: "Don't stop.
sentences.zh: “别停下来。

sentences.en: This is the last length."
sentences.zh: 这是最后一圈了。”

sentences.en: So Chip went on and everyone was pleased.
sentences.zh: 于是 Chip 继续游了下去，大家都很高兴。

sentences.en: Next they had to swim to the bottom of the pool.
sentences.zh: 接下来，他们必须游到泳池的底部。

sentences.en: They had to pick up a brick and swim with it to the top.
sentences.zh: 他们必须捡起一块砖，带着它游到水面。

sentences.en: All the children passed the swimming test.
sentences.zh: 所有孩子都通过了游泳测试。

sentences.en: Mrs. May was very pleased.
sentences.zh: 太太。

sentences.en: "Well done, everyone," she said.
sentences.zh: 好做完， 每个人， 她说。

sentences.en: The children were pleased too.
sentences.zh: 孩子们也很高兴。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip told Mum and Dad about the swimming test.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 把游泳测试的事告诉了妈妈和爸爸。

sentences.en: "We passed," They said.
sentences.zh: “我们通过了。” 他们说。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad were very pleased too.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸也很高兴。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad had a surprise for them.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸给他们准备了一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip couldn't see what the surprise was.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 看不出是什么惊喜。

sentences.en: "What is it?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: “这是什么？” Biff 问道。

sentences.en: "It's a ball."
sentences.zh: “这是一只猫头鹰。

sentences.en: "It's a fish tank," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是一个鱼容器， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Said Biff.
sentences.zh: Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "What a lovely surprise."
sentences.zh: “真是个惊喜！”

sentences.en: Everyone looked at the fish swimming about in the tank.
sentences.zh: 大家都看着鱼缸里游来游去的鱼。

sentences.en: "There is room for more fish," Said Dad.
sentences.zh: “鱼缸里还有空间，可以多放几条鱼。” 爸爸说道。

sentences.en: "We can get some next time we go shopping."
sentences.zh: “我们下次去购物的时候可以再买一些。”

sentences.en: The next day they went shopping.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他们去购物了。

sentences.en: Dad took them to a shop that sold fish.
sentences.zh: 爸爸带他们去了一家卖鱼的商店。

sentences.en: "What a lovely shop!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “这家店真漂亮。” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "Look at all the fish."
sentences.zh: “看看这些鱼！”

sentences.en: There were big fish and little fish.
sentences.zh: 有大鱼也有小鱼。

sentences.en: Kipper liked the big fish in a tank.
sentences.zh: Kipper 喜欢鱼缸里的大鱼。

sentences.en: "Don't tap the glass," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 不龙头这玻璃， 说爸爸。 爸爸说道。

sentences.en: "The fish don't like it."
sentences.zh: “鱼不喜欢这样。”

sentences.en: Dad put some more fish in the tank.
sentences.zh: 爸爸又往鱼缸里放了一些鱼。

sentences.en: He put rocks on the bottom.
sentences.zh: 他在鱼缸底部放了一些石头。

sentences.en: Next to the rocks, he put a ship and a little box.
sentences.zh: 在石头旁边，他放了一艘船和一个小盒子。

sentences.en: Wilma and Nadim came to see the fish tank.
sentences.zh: Wilma 和她的团队过来看看鱼缸。

sentences.en: "It looks lovely," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: “看起来真漂亮。” Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: "I wish I could swim in there."
sentences.zh: “我真希望我能在那里面游泳。”

sentences.en: They went to play in Biff's room.
sentences.zh: 他们去 Biff 的房间玩。

sentences.en: It took Chip ran in with the magic key.
sentences.zh: 它拿 Chip 跑在……里和……一起这魔法钥匙。

sentences.en: Key was glowing.
sentences.zh: 钥匙在发光。

sentences.en: "It's time for an adventure," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “是时候去冒险了。” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: The magic began to work.
sentences.zh: 魔法开始起作用了。

sentences.en: It took the children into a new adventure.
sentences.zh: 它将孩子们带入了一场新的冒险。

sentences.en: This time, it was a different sort of adventure.
sentences.zh: 这一次，是一次与众不同的冒险。

sentences.en: The magic took them underwater.
sentences.zh: 魔法把他们带到了水下。

sentences.en: The children had masks and flippers and tanks of air.
sentences.zh: 孩子们戴着面罩，穿着蛙鞋，背着氧气罐。

sentences.en: They could swim underwater.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在水下游泳。

sentences.en: The children had never seen so many fish.
sentences.zh: 孩子们从未见过这么多鱼。

sentences.en: They were all different colors.
sentences.zh: 它们都是不同的颜色。

sentences.en: "This is better than the pool," thought Chip.
sentences.zh: 这个是更好的比这池塘， 想 Chip。

sentences.en: "I feel like a fish," thought Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我感觉喜欢一个鱼， 想 Wilma。

sentences.en: Thought Wilma.
sentences.zh: Wilma 心想。

sentences.en: The children loved swimming under the water.
sentences.zh: 孩子们喜欢在水下游泳。

sentences.en: It was lovely to see all the fish and to swim with them.
sentences.zh: 看到所有的鱼并和它们一起游泳真好。

sentences.en: Chip and Nadim swam to the bottom and picked up a big shell.
sentences.zh: Chip 和他的小伙伴们游到海底，捡起了一只大贝壳。

sentences.en: Looked at a jellyfish but she didn't swim too close.
sentences.zh: Biff 看着一只水母，但她没有游得太近。

sentences.en: They saw a ship under the water.
sentences.zh: 他们在水下看到了一艘船。

sentences.en: It was an old ship that had been under the water for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这是一艘老船，已经在水下沉睡了很长时间。

sentences.en: They swam up to the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们游到船边。

sentences.en: Wilma didn't want to swim too close to it.
sentences.zh: Wilma 不想游得太靠近它。

sentences.en: It looked dangerous.
sentences.zh: 它看起来很危险。

sentences.en: They saw an octopus.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了一只章鱼。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: “哎呀，不好了。”

sentences.en: It was sitting on a chest.
sentences.zh: 它是坐在……上一个胸膛。

sentences.en: They couldn't look inside the chest with an octopus sitting on the lid.
sentences.zh: 一只章鱼趴在箱盖上，他们没法看清箱子里面。

sentences.en: They blew bubbles at the octopus.
sentences.zh: 他们对着章鱼吹泡泡。

sentences.en: The octopus didn't like the bubbles, so it swam away.
sentences.zh: 章鱼不喜欢气泡，于是游走了。

sentences.en: "Good!" Thought the children.
sentences.zh: “太好了！” 孩子们心想。

sentences.en: "Now we can look inside."
sentences.zh: “现在我们可以看看里面了！”

sentences.en: The children opened up the chest and looked inside.
sentences.zh: 孩子们打开箱子，往里面看。

sentences.en: It was a treasure chest, and it was full of gold.
sentences.zh: 这是一个宝箱，里面装满了金子。

sentences.en: Biff and Wilma pushed the chest over, and all the gold fell out.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Wilma 把箱子推倒，所有的金子都掉了出来。

sentences.en: Picked up a necklace and Biff picked up a gold cup.
sentences.zh: Nadine 拿起了一条项链，Biff 拿起了一个金杯。

sentences.en: Biff and Nadim were busy looking at the treasure.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Nadine 正忙着看宝藏。

sentences.en: They didn't see what Chip and Wilma saw.
sentences.zh: 他们没有看到 Chip 和 Wilma 看到的东西。

sentences.en: A shark was coming!
sentences.zh: 一条鲨鱼游过来了！

sentences.en: Chip and Wilma couldn't tell Biff and Nadim.
sentences.zh: Chip 和 Wilma 来不及告诉 Biff 和 Nadine。

sentences.en: They pulled them away and pointed at the shark.
sentences.zh: 他们拉着 Biff 和 Nadine 离开，指着鲨鱼。

sentences.en: The children were frightened.
sentences.zh: 孩子们吓坏了。

sentences.en: They swam and swam, but the shark swam after them.
sentences.zh: 他们拼命地游啊游，但鲨鱼却一直跟着他们。

sentences.en: Then the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这时，魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: The magic key took them out of the adventure.
sentences.zh: 魔法钥匙把他们带出了这次冒险。

sentences.en: "Wow!
What an adventure!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 真是一次精彩的冒险啊！” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "The treasure chest was like the one in our fish tank." "Look!
sentences.zh: “那个宝箱和我们鱼缸里的宝箱一样。” “看！

sentences.en: There's the treasure!" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 宝藏在那里！” Chip 说道。

sentences.en: The children ran to look in the fish tank.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跑过去看鱼缸。

sentences.en: "How did it get there?" Asked Nadim.
sentences.zh: “它是怎么到那里的？” Nadim 问道。

sentences.en: "It's magic!"
sentences.zh: “这是魔法！”
